analysis: Results plateau at about 0.995-1.0 dev success for the depth-3, width-64 conv recipe with 4 PPO epochs and 128 envs. The baseline got 0.58. Layernorm, gelu, lr between 0.0007 and 0.002, entropy, clip and minibatch changes all land within seed noise (about ±0.003). The two failures were width 32 (0.945) and bonus 5 with step penalty 0.01 at lr 0.0015 (0.936), so that combination is unstable at high lr. Wall time is about 310-345s, safely under the 600s limit. Remaining gains are noise-level, so I'll test small variants of the plateau recipe and one repeat.

proposals.hypothesis: Noise repeat of t10/t19 style (gelu, layernorm, lr 0.0007) with ent 0.005 and clip 0.2 as a mid-point. Refuted if dev success is below 0.996.

Gamma 0.9 shortens the credit horizon, so each placement is judged by its immediate cell reward. That could sharpen the policy on the relu and layernorm recipe at lr 0.001. Refuted if dev success is below 0.996.
A tighter gradient clip (0.5) with lr 0.0015 may stabilise the late-training policy and remove the rare failures. Refuted if dev success is below 0.996.
Noise repeat of t23/t26 (gelu, layernorm, 8 minibatches, lr 0.001, ent 0.005, scored 1.0 and 0.998) with clip 0.3 as the only change. Refuted if dev success is below 0.996.
